# Large Flat Face

Area of one flat face: large flat areas warp, and resin layers across one peel hard.

<figure markdown="span">
![Large Flat Face: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-flat-face-area-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Large Flat Face: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/max-flat-face-area-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Area of a single flat face.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Resin 3D Printing (SLA)](../../reference/processes/resin-3d-printing.md) | Low |
| [Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)](../../reference/processes/powder-bed-fusion.md) | Low |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    Criticality in this process: **Low** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 2,500 mm² | Engineering judgement, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-sla "Xometry advises against large flat faces parallel to the platform, without a figure. 2,500 mm² is a 50 mm square") |

    Every other material uses the Default values: Standard Resin, Tough / Durable Resin, Flexible / Elastic Resin.


=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    Criticality in this process: **Low** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

    | Material | Aim for | Source |
    | :-- | :-- | :-- |
    | **Default** | 10,000 mm² | Engineering judgement, [Xometry](../../citations/bibliography.md#xometry-mjf "Both advise against large flat faces, without a figure. 10,000 mm² is a 100 mm square"), [Stratasys](../../citations/bibliography.md#stratasys-sls) |

    Every other material uses the Default values: PA12 (SLS), PA12 (MJF), PA11, PA12 Carbon-filled, TPU.


## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

=== "Resin 3D Printing (SLA)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Large flat layer (`{measured}`): `{feature}` lies flat in the layers over `{size}`, more than the recommended `{target}`. Each layer across it peels off the tank with a large force, which can distort it or pull the part off its supports. Tilt the part 30 to 45° on the platform.

=== "Powder Bed Fusion (SLS)"

    !!! warning "Warning"

        Large flat face (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, more than the recommended `{target}`. Large flat panels cool unevenly in the powder and warp. Where you can, give it a slight curve or split it into smaller panels, and keep its thickness even.

| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
